abstract: OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study was to present our experience with laparoscopically assisted vaginal ovarian cystectomy (LAVOC) in selected patients with various large ovarian masses. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Among the medical records of 324 patients with ovarian masses, 10 consecutive women of reproductive age with prior sexual activity and with large ovarian masses (10-27 cm) were evaluated. A combined laparoscopic and vaginal ovarian cystectomy was done through the posterior cul-de-sac. RESULTS: All operations proceeded smoothly; the ovarian pathologies included 1 mucinous cystadenoma, 1 serous cystadenoma, 1 mucinous cystadenoma coexisting with mature cystic teratoma, and 7 mature cystic teratomas. The median (range) tumor size was 15.5 cm (range, 10-27), operative duration was 62 minutes (range, 31-110), the estimated blood loss 50 mL (range, 10-150), and the hospital stay was 2 days (range, 1-4). No open conversion and blood transfusion was required, and no patient had major perioperative complications. One patient suffered from postoperative low-grade fever (<38.5 degrees C) controlled by 3-day parenteral antibiotic therapy. CONCLUSIONS: LAVOC is safe and feasible and can be an alternative to traditional laparotomy and the pure laparoscopic approach in selected patients. The potential risk of postoperative infection has to be kept in mind.
abstract_ja: 目的:大きな各種卵巣腫瘤を有する選択された患者に対する腹腔鏡補助下経腟卵巣嚢胞摘出術(LAVOC)の経験を報告すること。対象と方法:卵巣腫瘤を有する324例の患者の診療記録のうち、大きな卵巣腫瘤(10〜27cm)を有する生殖年齢で性交渉歴のある連続10例を評価した。後膣円蓋経由で腹腔鏡と経腟の併用による卵巣嚢胞摘出術を行った。結果:すべての手術は順調に行われた。卵巣病変の内訳は、粘液性嚢胞腺腫1例、漿液性嚢胞腺腫1例、粘液性嚢胞腺腫と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の併存1例、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫7例であった。腫瘍径の中央値は15.5cm(範囲10〜27cm)、手術時間の中央値は62分(範囲31〜110分)、推定出血量は50mL(範囲10〜150mL)、在院日数は2日(範囲1〜4日)であった。開腹移行や輸血は必要なく、重篤な術後合併症を生じた患者はいなかった。術後に低度発熱(38.5℃未満)を1例認め、3日間の非経口抗菌薬投与で管理された。結論:LAVOCは安全で実施可能であり、選択された患者において開腹術や純粋な腹腔鏡手術の代替となりうる。術後感染の潜在的リスクに留意すべきである。
